recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It preserves the original FHIR-13500 guardrail while reflecting later published expansions; do not publish a separate FHIR-34462 commit from this worker because that issue is already represented on the combined branch.
issue_request: FHIR-13500 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core change request to constrain ElementDefinition.type.targetProfile because nothing prevented it from being used on illegal type codes; the accepted rationale was that Reference was then the only datatype that could reference another resource.
initial_application: The seed was applied by svn-backed commit f72d0b9673237211ead8d337c3c4d779faf2ed20, '#13500 - constraint on ElementDefinition', at build revision 12733, adding eld-17 with Reference-only targetProfile logic in source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml.
additional_context: Later published decisions broadened the same constraint family: FHIR-17433 allowed targetProfile for canonical, and FHIR-34462 allowed CodeableReference. The combined branch already contains the FHIR-34462 reconciliation commit d1400c5ee30227564a382bb4f815425278feed4d. ElementDefinition is active and normative in source/fhir.ini, and the current eld-17 executable constraint already permits Reference, canonical, and CodeableReference.
reconciliation: Updated source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml so the ElementDefinition.type.targetProfile short definition and definition text include CodeableReference alongside Reference and canonical. This fixes the remaining reader-facing inconsistency without changing the executable eld-17 expressions.
source_changes: source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml: updated ElementDefinition.type.targetProfile short definition and definition text to include CodeableReference alongside Reference and canonical.
